sloka: शत योजन विस्तीर्णम् विमलम् चारु दर्शनम् ।श्लक्ष्णम् श्रीमन् महच् चैव दुष्प्रापम् शकुनैर् अपि ।। ६-३९-१९।।
transliteration: śata yojana vistīrṇam vimalam cāru darśanam ।ślakṣṇam śrīman mahac caiva duṣprāpam śakunair api ।। 6-39-19।।

translations.english: Trikuta peak was fully covered with flowers, sparkled with gold, spread over a hundred yojanas, beautiful to look at, splendid and smooth. It is difficult even for birds to reach, for sages even in thought and difficult to access by any physical action. It is praiseworthy as if touching the sky alone.
